description: Forge — Silent Memory Forger for AI agents

first_time.note: Run 'forge init' to set up the database and hooks, then 'forge start' to launch the daemon.

daemon_not_running.note: Run after a reboot or if any tool returns 'Daemon unreachable'.

get_recent_context.description: Returns distilled memories and session summaries from past work.
get_recent_context.when_to_use: User asks about past work, decisions, or patterns.

search_memories.when_to_use: User asks 'did I fix this before?' or about past errors.

get_principles.description: Returns distilled high-level principles (architecture decisions, patterns, preferences).
get_principles.when_to_use: User asks about project conventions or past decisions.

get_session_summaries.description: Returns synthesized summaries of recent work sessions.
get_session_summaries.when_to_use: User asks what they were working on before a break or yesterday.
